name: Jamka
source:
The first companion that Ryu meets on his journey.
Something about him screams scoundrel, but in fact he is actually quite dependable. 
He is also an expert shot with a bow.

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20071130073856/http://www.hirameki-int.com/apdvd/products/dragonia/p_cha02.html]official site[/url]]
